## Point Blank PC Port v1.1.0

Namco's Point Blank (PlayStation) running natively on Windows. Aim with your mouse or a controller, no light gun or CRT TV needed.

### New in this release
- **Ready to play.** Download, unzip and run. No build tools or compiling.
- **Install your disc in the launcher.** Browse for your `Point Blank (USA).cue`; the launcher checks it is the right game, and **Install To Game Folder** copies it next to the game with a progress bar.
- **PC graphics options:** FXAA, contrast-adaptive sharpening, brightness and an FPS counter, alongside internal resolution, fullscreen, VSync, texture filtering, scanlines and the rest.
- **Light gun settings:** crosshair off / controller only / always (replacing the mouse cursor), cross, dot or ring style in three sizes, and controller aim speed.

**This download contains no game data.** You need your own disc image of **Point Blank (USA)** (SLUS-00481), as a `.cue` with its `.bin`.

### How to play
1. Download **PointBlank-PC-Port-v1.1.0-windows-x64.zip** below and unzip it anywhere.
2. Run **PointBlank_Recompiled.exe**.
3. Press **Browse For Disc**, pick your `.cue`, then **Install To Game Folder**.
4. Press **Play**. Shoot the centre of the calibration target, then press A (right click or Start).

### Controls
Mouse: left = shoot, right = A (start / skip), middle = B, point outside the picture to shoot off-screen.
Controller: sticks aim, RT / A / RB = shoot, LT / B = shoot off-screen, Start / X = A, Back / Y = B. A second controller plays as Player 2.

Windows SmartScreen may warn because the program is not code-signed: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.

This build was made with AI (Claude Code). See the README for details.
